question: At what times may the prescribed worship be performed?
premises: Worship may be done at the beginning of the day.
It may be done at midday.
It may be done at all three times.
inference: The rite may be performed in the morning, at midday, or at all three prescribed times.
uncertainties: The exact three times implied by samayatritaye are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: This may be done at the beginning of the day, or at midday, or at all three times.
